To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• We propose a novel approach for distributed inverted index construction in P2P systems, which is orders of magnitude faster than the state of theart approaches, while preserving high accuracy.

(1) we propose an algorithm which enables maintaining a distributed index with low network cost and high quality; (2) we show how to detect near duplicate files efficiently, by controlling the tradeoff among network cost, quality, and system requirements; (3) we propose an efficient scalable method for clustering text documents, which outperforms the existing methods with respect to quality and efficiency;

(1) efficient distributed indexing, clustering, near duplicate detection, and classification can be achieved in P2P systems by using a combination of approximation algorithms and data reduction techniques, and (2) the proposed methods are scalable and efficient, and can be used in a wide range of real-world applications.
